title: ruscus hypoglossum subsp. hypophyllum
intro: Ruscus hypoglossum subsp. hypophyllum, commonly known as Ruscus fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation and reducing stress due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. Ruscus fern is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects. The health benefits of Ruscus fern include lowering blood pressure, improving sleep quality, and reducing anxiety, making it a potential natural remedy for stress-related disorders.
